    Plot Shapefile with Map Elements

    ShapeMap.Rd

    Creates a map from a shapefile with optional coordinate limits, north arrow, and scale bar. This is a wrapper around sf and ggplot2 for quick shapefile visualization.

    ShapeMap(
  shapefile_path,
  xlim = NULL,
  ylim = NULL,
  add_north = TRUE,
  add_scale = TRUE,
  north_pos = "tl",
  scale_pos = "bl",
  fill_color = "grey90",
  border_color = "black",
  xlab = "Longitude",
  ylab = "Latitude"
)

    Arguments

    shapefile_path

    Character. Full path to the shapefile (.shp file).

    xlim

    Numeric vector of length 2. Longitude limits c(min, max). If NULL, uses full extent (default = NULL).

    ylim

    Numeric vector of length 2. Latitude limits c(min, max). If NULL, uses full extent (default = NULL).

    add_north

    Logical. Add north arrow? (default = TRUE).

    add_scale

    Logical. Add scale bar? (default = TRUE).

    north_pos

    Character. North arrow position: "tl" (top-left), "tr" (top-right), "bl" (bottom-left), "br" (bottom-right) (default = "tl").

    scale_pos

    Character. Scale bar position: same options as north_pos (default = "bl").

    fill_color

    Character. Fill color for polygons (default = "grey90").

    border_color

    Character. Border color for polygons (default = "black").

    xlab

    Character. X-axis label (default = "Longitude").

    ylab

    Character. Y-axis label (default = "Latitude").

    Value

    A ggplot object.

    Details

    This function reads a shapefile and creates a publication-ready map with optional north arrow and scale bar. Requires the sf and ggspatial packages.

    The function does NOT install packages automatically. Make sure you have installed sf and ggspatial before using: install.packages(c("sf", "ggspatial"))

    See also

    st_read for reading shapefiles, geom_sf for plotting spatial data

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Example 1: Use included Iceland shapefile
iceland_path <- get_example_shapefile()
ShapeMap(iceland_path)

# Example 2: Zoom to specific region
ShapeMap(iceland_path,
         xlim = c(-27.9, -12.5),
         ylim = c(63, 67))

# Example 3: Custom colors
ShapeMap(iceland_path,
         xlim = c(-27.9, -12.5),
         ylim = c(63, 67),
         fill_color = "lightblue",
         border_color = "navy",
         north_pos = "tr")

# Example 4: Your own shapefile
ShapeMap("path/to/your/shapefile.shp")
} # }
